subject: System Design
title: Blue-Green Deployments
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Blue-Green Deployments.

hook.text: You have two identical production environments: blue is live, green has the new version.

buildup.text: You deploy the update to green, test it thoroughly, then switch the load balancer to point at green.

discovery.text: If something goes wrong, switching back to blue is instant — no rollback required.

twist.text: Running two full environments doubles infrastructure cost during the transition window.

climax.text: Blue-green deployments trade cost for confidence: zero-downtime releases with instant rollback.

punchline.text: Two environments, zero downtime, instant rollback.

quiz.question: What is the main advantage of blue-green deployments?
options: Zero downtime with instant rollback capability
